name: Disenchant: Twilight Cultist set pieces can be disenchanted (COA-7173)
contract: The Twilight Cultist Cowl 20408, Mantle 20406 and Robe 20407 are uncommon item level 60 armour and use disenchant bracket 10 like their CoA copies. A character with Enchanting 300 casting Disenchant 13262 on the Cowl gets a disenchant loot window with at least one item, and closing it consumes the Cowl.

steps.label: the disenchant loot window holds materials
closing the loot window consumes the Cowl
